front: O viés de confirmação nos faz buscar apenas o que reforça nossas crenças.
pronunciation: oo vee-EHZ jee kohn-feer-mah-SOWNG nooz FAHZ boos-KAHR ah-PEH-nahz oo keh rreh-FOHR-sah NOH-sahs KREHN-sahs.
back: Confirmation bias makes us seek only what reinforces our beliefs.
context: 'Viés' = bias (plural 'vieses'). 'Crença' = belief. 'Fazer alguém' + infinitive = to make someone do something.

front: Quanto menos a pessoa sabe, mais confiante ela tende a se sentir.
pronunciation: KWAHN-too MEH-nooz ah peh-SOH-ah SAH-bee, MAHYS kohn-fee-AHN-chee EH-lah TEHN-jee ah see sehn-CHEER.
back: The less a person knows, the more confident they tend to feel.
context: The Dunning-Kruger effect. 'Quanto menos…, mais…' = the less…, the more…

front: Ele está em negação: não aceita que o relacionamento acabou.
pronunciation: EH-lee ehs-TAH eng neh-gah-SOWNG: NOWNG ah-SAY-tah keh oo rreh-lah-syoh-nah-MEHN-too ah-kah-BOH.
back: He's in denial: he won't accept that the relationship is over.
context: 'Estar em negação' = to be in denial, one of the classic defense mechanisms.

front: Ela projeta nos outros as inseguranças que não admite em si mesma.
pronunciation: EH-lah proh-ZHEH-tah nooz OH-trooz ahz een-seh-goo-RAHN-sahs keh NOWNG ahj-MEE-chee eng SEE MEHZ-mah.
back: She projects onto others the insecurities she won't admit in herself.
context: Projection as a defense mechanism. 'Em si mesma' = in herself (reflexive emphasis).

front: Isso não passa de uma racionalização para justificar a preguiça.
pronunciation: EE-soo NOWNG PAH-sah jee OO-mah rrah-syoh-nah-lee-zah-SOWNG PAH-rah zhoos-chee-fee-KAHR ah preh-GEE-sah.
back: That's nothing but a rationalization to justify laziness.
context: Rationalization: inventing logical reasons for emotionally driven behavior.

front: Ele descontou no filho a raiva que sentia do chefe.
pronunciation: EH-lee jehs-kohn-TOH noo FEE-lyoo ah RRAHY-vah keh sehn-CHEE-ah doo SHEH-fee.
back: He took out on his son the anger he felt toward his boss.
context: Displacement. 'Descontar em alguém' = to take something out on someone.

front: Ela sublimou a dor da perda em música.
pronunciation: EH-lah soo-blee-MOH ah DOHR dah PEHR-dah eng MOO-zee-kah.
back: She channeled the pain of her loss into music.
context: Sublimation: turning difficult impulses into socially valued activities. 'Perda' = loss.

front: Fazer terapia não é sinal de fraqueza, e sim de autocuidado.
pronunciation: fah-ZEHR teh-rah-PEE-ah NOWNG EH see-NAHL jee frah-KEH-zah, ee SEENG jee ow-toh-kwee-DAH-doo.
back: Going to therapy isn't a sign of weakness, but of self-care.
context: 'Fazer terapia' = to be in therapy. Brazil is among the world's largest consumers of psychotherapy.

front: O autoconhecimento é um processo que nunca termina.
pronunciation: oo ow-toh-koh-nyeh-see-MEHN-too EH oong proh-SEH-soo keh NOON-kah tehr-MEE-nah.
back: Self-knowledge is a process that never ends.
context: 'Auto-' prefix: autoconhecimento, autoestima, autocrítica (written together).

front: A baixa autoestima a impede de aceitar elogios.
pronunciation: ah BAHY-shah ow-toh-ehs-CHEE-mah ah eem-PEH-jee jee ah-say-TAHR eh-loh-ZHEE-oos.
back: Low self-esteem keeps her from accepting compliments.
context: 'Impedir alguém de' + infinitive = to prevent someone from. 'A impede' = prevents her.

front: Procrastinar é, muitas vezes, uma forma de evitar a ansiedade.
pronunciation: proh-krahs-chee-NAHR EH, MOOY-tahz VEH-zees, OO-mah FOHR-mah jee eh-vee-TAHR ah ahn-see-eh-DAH-jee.
back: Procrastinating is often a way of avoiding anxiety.
context: A reframing common in modern psychology: procrastination as emotion regulation, not laziness.

front: Resiliência não é não sofrer; é conseguir se reerguer.
pronunciation: rreh-zee-lee-EHN-syah NOWNG EH NOWNG soh-FREHR; EH kohn-seh-GEER see rree-ehr-GEHR.
back: Resilience isn't not suffering; it's being able to get back up.
context: 'Reerguer-se' = to rise again, get back on one's feet.

front: Nossas memórias são reconstruídas cada vez que as lembramos.
pronunciation: NOH-sahz meh-MOH-ryahs SOWNG rreh-kohns-troo-EE-dahs KAH-dah VEHS keh ahz lehm-BRAH-moos.
back: Our memories are reconstructed every time we recall them.
context: 'Cada vez que' = every time. Memory is reconstructive, not a recording.

front: O hábito se forma pela repetição até se tornar automático.
pronunciation: oo AH-bee-too see FOHR-mah PEH-lah rreh-peh-chee-SOWNG ah-TEH see tohr-NAHR ow-toh-MAH-chee-koo.
back: A habit forms through repetition until it becomes automatic.
context: 'Tornar-se' = to become. The same principle behind spaced repetition!

front: Só sei que nada sei.
pronunciation: SOH SAY keh NAH-dah SAY.
back: All I know is that I know nothing.
context: Attributed to Socrates. The starting point of philosophical humility.

front: Penso, logo existo.
pronunciation: PEHN-soo, LOH-goo eh-ZEES-too.
back: I think, therefore I am.
context: Descartes' 'Cogito, ergo sum'. 'Logo' here = therefore (not 'soon').

front: Ninguém se banha duas vezes no mesmo rio.
pronunciation: neen-GENG see BAH-nyah DOO-ahz VEH-zeez noo MEHZ-moo RREE-oo.
back: No one bathes twice in the same river.
context: Heraclitus: everything flows, and both the river and the person change.

front: Segundo Sartre, o ser humano está condenado a ser livre.
pronunciation: seh-GOON-doo SAHR-tree, oo SEHR oo-MAH-noo ehs-TAH kohn-deh-NAH-doo ah SEHR LEE-vree.
back: According to Sartre, human beings are condemned to be free.
context: Existentialism: we can't escape choosing, and so we're responsible for what we make of ourselves.

front: A angústia surge diante da liberdade de escolher.
pronunciation: ah ahn-GOOS-chee-ah SOOR-zhee jee-AHN-chee dah lee-behr-DAH-jee jee ehs-koh-LYEHR.
back: Anguish arises in the face of the freedom to choose.
context: 'Angústia' (anguish) is a key existentialist concept (Kierkegaard, Sartre). 'Diante de' = in the face of.

front: Qual é o sentido da vida, se é que existe algum?
pronunciation: KWAHL EH oo sehn-CHEE-doo dah VEE-dah, see EH keh eh-ZEES-chee ahl-GOONG?
back: What is the meaning of life, if there is any?
context: 'Se é que' = if indeed. 'Sentido' = meaning (also sense, direction).

front: Para Camus, devemos imaginar Sísifo feliz.
pronunciation: PAH-rah kah-MOO, deh-VEH-mooz ee-mah-zhee-NAHR SEE-zee-foo feh-LEES.
back: For Camus, we must imagine Sisyphus happy.
context: Absurdism: finding meaning in the struggle itself, despite a world without inherent meaning.

front: Eu sou eu e minha circunstância.
pronunciation: EH-oo SOH EH-oo ee MEE-nyah seer-koons-TAHN-syah.
back: I am myself and my circumstance.
context: Ortega y Gasset: identity can't be separated from the context we live in.

front: A identidade não é fixa: ela se constrói nas relações com os outros.
pronunciation: ah ee-dehn-chee-DAH-jee NOWNG EH FEEK-sah: EH-lah see kohns-TROY nahz rreh-lah-SOYNGS kohng ooz OH-troos.
back: Identity isn't fixed: it is built through our relationships with others.
context: 'Construir-se' = to be built, construct oneself. Note the irregular 'constrói'.

front: A alteridade é a capacidade de se colocar no lugar do outro.
pronunciation: ah ahl-teh-ree-DAH-jee EH ah kah-pah-see-DAH-jee jee see koh-loh-KAHR noo loo-GAHR doo OH-troo.
back: Alterity is the ability to put yourself in the other person's shoes.
context: 'Alteridade' (otherness) is a favorite word in Brazilian humanities. 'Colocar-se no lugar do outro' = to empathize.

front: Somos feitos de contradições, e tudo bem.
pronunciation: SOH-mooz FAY-tooz jee kohn-trah-jee-SOYNGS, ee TOO-doo BENG.
back: We're made of contradictions, and that's okay.
context: 'E tudo bem' = and that's fine. Echoes Walt Whitman's 'I contain multitudes'.

front: A ética pergunta não o que podemos fazer, mas o que devemos fazer.
pronunciation: ah EH-chee-kah pehr-GOON-tah NOWNG oo keh poh-DEH-mooz fah-ZEHR, mahz oo keh deh-VEH-mooz fah-ZEHR.
back: Ethics asks not what we can do, but what we should do.
context: 'Poder' (ability or permission) vs 'dever' (obligation), a classic distinction.

front: Os fins justificam os meios?
pronunciation: oos FEENZ zhoos-chee-FEE-kowng ooz MAY-oos?
back: Does the end justify the means?
context: Debate associated with Machiavelli. Note the plural in Portuguese: 'os fins', 'os meios'.

front: Kant defendia que devemos tratar as pessoas sempre como fins, nunca apenas como meios.
pronunciation: KAHN-chee deh-fehn-JEE-ah keh deh-VEH-moos trah-TAHR ahs peh-SOH-ahs SEHM-pree KOH-moo FEENS, NOON-kah ah-PEH-nahs KOH-moo MAY-oos.
back: Kant argued that we must always treat people as ends, never merely as means.
context: A formulation of Kant's categorical imperative. 'Defender que' = to argue that.

front: Na alegoria da caverna, os prisioneiros confundem sombras com a realidade.
pronunciation: nah ah-leh-goh-REE-ah dah kah-VEHR-nah, oos pree-zee-oh-NAY-rooz kohn-FOON-deng SOHM-brahs kohng ah rreh-ah-lee-DAH-jee.
back: In the allegory of the cave, the prisoners mistake shadows for reality.
context: Plato's Republic. 'Confundir X com Y' = to mistake X for Y.

front: Nem tudo que é legal é moral, e nem tudo que é moral é legal.
pronunciation: NENG TOO-doo keh EH leh-GAHL EH moh-RAHL, ee NENG TOO-doo keh EH moh-RAHL EH leh-GAHL.
back: Not everything legal is moral, and not everything moral is legal.
context: 'Legal' here = lawful. Careful: in everyday Brazilian Portuguese 'legal' also means 'cool'!

front: O inconsciente, para Freud, guarda desejos que reprimimos.
pronunciation: oo een-kohn-see-EHN-chee, PAH-rah FROY-jee, GWAHR-dah deh-ZEH-zhooz keh rreh-pree-MEE-moos.
back: For Freud, the unconscious holds desires we repress.
context: 'Reprimir' = to repress. Psychoanalysis has a strong tradition in Brazil, especially in São Paulo and Rio.

front: Ele tem um ato falho atrás do outro quando fala da ex.
pronunciation: EH-lee teng oong AH-too FAH-lyoo ah-TRAHZ doo OH-troo KWAHN-doo FAH-lah dah EHS.
back: He makes one Freudian slip after another when he talks about his ex.
context: 'Ato falho' = Freudian slip. 'Um atrás do outro' = one after another.

front: Comparar a sua vida com a dos outros nas redes sociais gera frustração.
pronunciation: kohm-pah-RAHR ah SOO-ah VEE-dah kohng ah dooz OH-troos nahz RREH-jeez soh-SYAHYS ZHEH-rah froos-trah-SOWNG.
back: Comparing your life with other people's on social media leads to frustration.
context: 'A dos outros' = a vida dos outros. 'Gerar' = to generate, cause.

front: Estar sempre ocupado pode ser uma fuga de si mesmo.
pronunciation: ehs-TAHR SEHM-pree oh-koo-PAH-doo POH-jee SEHR OO-mah FOO-gah jee SEE MEHZ-moo.
back: Always being busy can be a way of running away from yourself.
context: 'Fuga' = escape, flight. 'De si mesmo' = from oneself.

front: Aceitar o que não podemos controlar traz uma certa paz.
pronunciation: ah-say-TAHR oo keh NOWNG poh-DEH-mooz kohn-troh-LAHR TRAHZ OO-mah SEHR-tah PAHS.
back: Accepting what we can't control brings a certain peace.
context: Stoic idea (Epictetus). 'Uma certa' before a noun = a certain.

front: Viver no piloto automático nos impede de perceber o presente.
pronunciation: vee-VEHR noo pee-LOH-too ow-toh-MAH-chee-koo nooz eem-PEH-jee jee pehr-seh-BEHR oo preh-ZEHN-chee.
back: Living on autopilot keeps us from noticing the present.
context: 'Viver no piloto automático' = to live on autopilot. Linked to mindfulness ('atenção plena').

front: O tédio pode ser o começo da criatividade.
pronunciation: oo TEH-jee-oo POH-jee SEHR oo koh-MEH-soo dah kree-ah-chee-vee-DAH-jee.
back: Boredom can be the beginning of creativity.
context: 'Tédio' = boredom. A popular idea in debates about constant phone use.

front: A felicidade não é um destino, mas uma maneira de caminhar.
pronunciation: ah feh-lee-see-DAH-jee NOWNG EH oong dehs-CHEE-noo, mahz OO-mah mah-NAY-rah jee kah-mee-NYAHR.
back: Happiness isn't a destination, but a way of walking.
context: 'Não é…, mas…' = it isn't…, but rather… A common aphoristic structure.

front: Errar é humano; persistir no erro é que não é.
pronunciation: eh-RRAHR EH oo-MAH-noo; pehr-sees-CHEER noo EH-rroo EH keh NOWNG EH.
back: To err is human; persisting in the error is not.
context: From the Latin 'Errare humanum est, perseverare diabolicum'. 'É que não é' adds emphasis.

front: A culpa paralisa; a responsabilidade mobiliza.
pronunciation: ah KOOL-pah pah-rah-LEE-zah; ah rrehs-pohn-sah-bee-lee-DAH-jee moh-bee-LEE-zah.
back: Guilt paralyzes; responsibility mobilizes.
context: Parallel antithesis, a structure that makes ideas memorable.

front: Nem sempre temos escolha sobre o que sentimos, mas temos sobre o que fazemos.
pronunciation: NENG SEHM-pree TEH-mooz ehs-KOH-lyah SOH-bree oo keh sehn-CHEE-moos, mahs TEH-mooz SOH-bree oo keh fah-ZEH-moos.
back: We don't always choose what we feel, but we do choose what we do.
context: Ellipsis: 'mas temos [escolha] sobre…' A key idea in cognitive-behavioral therapy.

front: O luto não segue uma linha reta: tem idas e vindas.
pronunciation: oo LOO-too NOWNG SEH-gee OO-mah LEE-nyah RREH-tah: teng EE-dahz ee VEEN-dahs.
back: Grief doesn't follow a straight line: it comes and goes.
context: 'Luto' = grief, mourning ('estar de luto' = to be in mourning). 'Idas e vindas' = comings and goings.

front: A pressa de ser produtivo o tempo todo também é uma forma de ansiedade.
pronunciation: ah PREH-sah jee SEHR proh-doo-CHEE-voo oo TEHM-poo TOH-doo tahm-BENG EH OO-mah FOHR-mah jee ahn-see-eh-DAH-jee.
back: The rush to be productive all the time is also a form of anxiety.
context: A critique of productivity culture, a frequent theme in Brazilian podcasts and columns.

front: Pensar sobre o próprio pensamento é o que chamamos de metacognição.
pronunciation: pehn-SAHR SOH-bree oo PROH-pree-oo pehn-sah-MEHN-too EH oo keh shah-MAH-mooz jee meh-tah-kohg-nee-SOWNG.
back: Thinking about one's own thinking is what we call metacognition.
context: 'Chamar de' = to call (something by a name). Metacognition helps you learn languages better.

front: Toda escolha implica uma renúncia.
pronunciation: TOH-dah ehs-KOH-lyah eem-PLEE-kah OO-mah rreh-NOON-syah.
back: Every choice implies giving something up.
context: 'Renúncia' = renunciation, giving up. The idea of opportunity cost, applied to life.
